$note: Single source for cuneiform fonts and the period/language -> font rule table. Read by web/js/fontmap.js (reader), scripts/font_map.py (build_static.py, build_catalog.py). Rules are tried in order; the first whose regexes (case-insensitive; missing = any) all match wins, else 'default'. Families follow the eBL cuneiform converter (ebl-frontend CuneiformConverterForm.tsx). Vanseveren faces are the exact files distributed in ebl-frontend (commit 9916eb1d), unconverted, because their terms forbid modified copies; the two OFL faces were repackaged as WOFF2 (lossless, no subsetting).
